## Tested on a real Steam Link?

## Checklist

- [ ] Line added under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Docs updated (CONFIG.md for new config keys, integrations/ for new inputs)
- [ ] Anything network-facing is off by default and allow-listed
- [ ] No server URLs, tokens or personal details in code, logs or screenshots
